title: AW27 Women's Celebrity Influence
summary: Front-row and red-carpet influence for AW27 will favour opulence and personal styling; customers style themselves.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-runway forecast. The AW27 shows run from January to March 2027. This report is built from the 2026 yarn, fabric and leather fairs (Pitti Filati in June; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica in September), published forecaster views and the SS27 runways. Forecut will update it after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Boland's "Dramatic Antidote" and "Unapologetic Presence" seek beauty and seduction; she quotes Dries Van Noten: "The only answer to these times is beauty"<sup>[1]</sup>
- Jan Agelink's "Age of Agency": a messy, lived-in aesthetic, layering by construction, pixelated "glitch meets nature" checks, and watches used as styling devices<sup>[2]</sup>
- Menswear forecaster Edwin van den Hoek: jackets, trousers and down grow bigger without weight ("It looks very big, but it is very light to wear"); layering at the neck; fur or hairy collars; leather as a refined detail<sup>[1]</sup>

sections.heading: What to take from it
sections.body:
- Watches and jewellery used as styling devices.
- Personal, layered looks rather than head-to-toe brand.
- Avoid celebrity names and likenesses in marketing without agreements.

design_implications: - Design pieces that style many ways.
